title: Pan-cancer analysis of co-occurring mutations in RAD52 and the BRCA1-BRCA2-PALB2 axis in human cancers.
authors: Hamid, Abdulaziz B; Frank, Lauren E; Bouley, Renee A; Petreaca, Ruben C
one_liner_zh: 该文基于COSMIC数据库做RAD52与BRCA1-BRCA2-PALB2轴共突变泛癌分析，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作（RAD52-DNA关联）和分子建模，但核心是肿瘤突变统计与表型关联，非TF-DNA结合体系，AI/物理模拟方法仅浅层应用，与本课题匹配度低。
abstract: In human cells homologous recombination (HR) is critical for repair of DNA double strand breaks (DSBs) and rescue of stalled or collapsed replication forks. HR is facilitated by RAD51 which is loaded onto DNA by either BRCA2-BRCA1-PALB2 or RAD52. In human culture cells, double-knockdowns of RAD52 and genes in the BRCA1-BRCA2-PALB2 axis are lethal. Mutations in BRCA2, BRCA1 or PALB2 significantly impairs error free HR as RAD51 loading relies on RAD52 which is not as proficient as BRCA2-BRCA1-PALB2. RAD52 also facilitates Single Strand Annealing (SSA) that produces intra-chromosomal deletions. Some RAD52 mutations that affect the SSA function or decrease RAD52 association with DNA can suppress certain BRCA2 associated phenotypes in breast cancers. In this report we did a pan-cancer analysis using data reported on the Catalogue of Somatic Mutations in Cancers (COSMIC) to identify double mutants between RAD52 and BRCA1, BRCA2 or PALB2 that occur in cancer cells. We find that co-occurring mutations are likely in certain cancer tissues but not others. However, all mutations occur in a heterozygous state. Further, using computational and machine learning tools we identified only a handful of pathogenic or driver mutations predicted to significantly affect the function of the proteins. This supports previous findings that co-inactivation of RAD52 with any members of the BRCA2-BRCA1-PALB2 axis is lethal. Molecular modeling also revealed that pathogenic RAD52 mutations co-occurring with mutations in BRCA2-BRCA1-PALB2 axis are either expected to attenuate its SSA function or its interaction with DNA. This study extends previous breast cancer findings to other cancer types and shows that co-occurring mutations likely destabilize HR by similar mechanisms as in breast cancers.
abstract_zh: 在人类细胞中，同源重组（HR）对于修复DNA双链断裂（DSBs）以及拯救停滞或崩溃的复制叉至关重要。HR由RAD51促进，RAD51通过BRCA2-BRCA1-PALB2或RAD52加载到DNA上。在人类培养细胞中，RAD52与BRCA1-BRCA2-PALB2轴基因的双重敲低是致死的。BRCA2、BRCA1或PALB2的突变显著损害无错误HR，因为RAD51加载依赖于RAD52，而RAD52的效率不如BRCA2-BRCA1-PALB2。RAD52还促进单链退火（SSA），该过程产生染色体内缺失。某些影响SSA功能或降低RAD52与DNA结合的RAD52突变，可以抑制乳腺癌中某些与BRCA2相关的表型。在本报告中，我们使用癌症体细胞突变目录（COSMIC）中报告的数据进行了泛癌分析，以识别癌细胞中RAD52与BRCA1、BRCA2或PALB2之间的双突变。我们发现，共现突变可能在某些癌症组织中发生，但在其他组织中则不然。然而，所有突变均以杂合状态存在。此外，利用计算和机器学习工具，我们仅识别出少数预测显著影响蛋白质功能的致病性或驱动突变。这支持了先前的研究发现，即RAD52与BRCA2-BRCA1-PALB2轴任何成员的共失活是致死的。分子建模还揭示，与BRCA2-BRCA1-PALB2轴突变共现的致病性RAD52突变，预计要么削弱其SSA功能，要么削弱其与DNA的相互作用。本研究将先前的乳腺癌发现扩展到其他癌症类型，并表明共现突变可能通过类似于乳腺癌的机制使HR不稳定。
